capabilities: View .dxf files in tabs and read-only embeds
Measure distances, angles, radii and areas
Draw lines, circles, arcs, polylines, text, dimensions and hatches
Edit entities with move, rotate, scale, mirror, trim, fillet and offset tools
Manage layers with colour, linetype and visibility controls
extras: Early release: the README warns that editing round-trips are still being hardened and to back up drawings before editing; binary DXF is rejected (ASCII DXF only); some entity types like SPLINE and pattern hatches render as placeholders and are preserved unmodified on save.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, view, measure, or edit CAD DXF drawings inside the vault.
summary: DXF CAD viewer and editor that opens .dxf drawings in tabs and note embeds, with measuring, drawing, modify and layer tools.
